Package com.userservice.app.mapper

Class UserMapper

java.lang.Object
com.userservice.app.mapper.UserMapper
@Component public class UserMapper extends Object
A component responsible for mapping between User and various DTOs.

This class provides methods to convert between domain model objects (e.g., User, UserSurvey) and their corresponding Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) such as UserDto, UserInfoDto, and UserSurveyDto.

The mapping involves:

  • Transforming a UserDto into a User object and vice versa, while handling related entities.
  • Mapping a UserSurveyDto to a UserSurvey object, setting relevant attributes.
  • Converting a User object to a UserInfoDto including user-specific details.

This class relies on various service components for fetching related data:

  • InterestService for retrieving interests.
  • MaritalStatusService for retrieving marital status.
  • TitleService for retrieving titles.

  • Method Details

    • userDtotoUser

      public User userDtotoUser(UserDto userDto)
      Maps a UserDto to a User entity.

      This method populates a new User object using the provided UserDto. It also constructs a UserSurvey object if necessary and associates it with the User. Related entities like interests, marital status, and title are resolved using respective service methods.

      Parameters:
      userDto - the Data Transfer Object containing user information
      Returns:
      a User entity populated with the data from the DTO

    • userSurveyDtoToUserSurvey

      public UserSurvey userSurveyDtoToUserSurvey(UserSurveyDto userSurveyDto, User user)
      Maps a UserSurveyDto to a UserSurvey entity.

      This method populates a new UserSurvey object using the provided UserSurveyDto. It sets related attributes including interests, marital status, and title. The UserSurvey is then associated with the given User.

      Parameters:
      userSurveyDto - the Data Transfer Object containing user survey information
      user - the User entity to associate with the survey
      Returns:
      a UserSurvey entity populated with the data from the DTO

    • userToUserInfoDto

      public UserInfoDto userToUserInfoDto(User user)
      Maps a User entity to a UserInfoDto.

      This method extracts information from a User object and populates a UserInfoDto with user-specific details such as name, email, location, survey responses, and interests.

      Parameters:
      user - the User entity to be mapped
      Returns:
      a UserInfoDto populated with the user's information
